# Getting help

**Open an issue.** That is the whole process — there is no separate support
queue, no forum, and no ticket portal to learn.

Use the **"Ask a question / get help"** template on the repository you are
having trouble with. If you are not sure which repository that is, pick the one
closest and we will move it.

Questions are not an imposition. If something was hard to figure out, that is
usually a gap in our documentation, and we would rather hear about it than not.

## What happens next

Every new issue lands in a shared triage queue that we work through regularly.
We are a small team, so we would rather set an honest expectation than a
flattering one: you will normally hear from a human within a few business days.
Urgent breakage tends to move faster than that; open-ended design questions
sometimes move slower.

If an issue of yours has gone quiet and you think it should not have, say so in
a comment. That is not nagging — it genuinely helps us catch things that fell
through.

## Reporting a security problem

Do not use the issue tracker. See [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).
